system.description: A ritual long forbidden by the Tremere Pyramid as a needless risk to the Masquerade, but one Dr. Mortius predates the ban and still uses on his own Haven near Marquette University. Cast over three hours and fueled by three or more blood traits, it causes rumors to spread among mortals that a house is haunted, discouraging the curious and the skeptical alike from approaching. The effect fades after about ten years, at which point mortals begin describing the place as merely "run down" instead of haunted.
system.source: Milwaukee by Night, Chapter Three: The Kindred (used by Dr. Mortius despite the Tremere ban on this ritual)
